channel.title: Yorben Vandersleyen — Engineering & Apps
channel.description: Engineering logs and release announcements for native Apple ecosystem applications: Cockpit, Waybill, and modern software.

item.title: Building Cockpit: A Zero-Cloud macOS & iPad Productivity HUD
item.description: Technical deep dive into building Cockpit: A modular heads-up display engineered for macOS and iPadOS consolidating Calendar, Music, Notion, and Mail into a zero-cloud physical control surface with peer-to-peer Network.framework encryption.

item.title: Simulating 3D Logistics Dioramas on iPadOS with RealityKit & SwiftUI
item.description: Behind the scenes of Waybill: tactile 3D logistics idle dioramas on iPadOS powered by Apple's RealityKit engine, custom physics, procedural routing, and mathematical balance modeling.
